title: A new test for AI labs: Are you even trying to make money?
description: It’s getting hard to tell which AI labs. are actually trying to make money. We created a rating system to help sort it out.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Legal AI giant Harvey acquires Hexus as competition heats up in legal tech
description: Hexus founder and CEO Sakshi Pratap, who previously held engineering roles at Walmart, Oracle, and Google, tells TechCrunch that her San Francisco-based team has already joined Harvey, while the startup's India-based engineers will come onboard once Harvey establishes a Bangalore office.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Who’s behind AMI Labs, Yann LeCun’s ‘world model’ startup
description: Yann LeCun's new venture, AMI Labs, has drawn intense attention since the AI scientist left Meta to found it.
author: Anna Heim

title: How did Davos turn into a tech conference?
description: The World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in Davos felt different this year, and not just because Meta and Salesforce took over storefronts on the main promenade. AI dominated the conversation in a way that overshadowed traditional topics like climate change and global poverty, and the CEOs weren’t holding back. There was public criticism of trade policy, warnings about AI […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: Google Photos’ latest feature lets you meme yourself
description: The new feature lets you insert yourself into a meme in Google Photos.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Meta pauses teen access to AI characters ahead of new version
description: Meta today said that it is pausing teens' access to its AI characters globally across all its apps. The company mentioned that it is not abandoning its efforts but wants to develop an updated version of AI characters for teens.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: AI CEOs transformed Davos into a tech conference
description: The World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in Davos felt different this year, and not just because Meta and Salesforce took over storefronts on the main promenade. AI dominated the conversation in a way that overshadowed traditional topics like climate change and global poverty, and the CEOs weren’t holding back. There was public criticism of trade policy, warnings about AI […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane

title: OpenAI chief Sam Altman plans India visit as AI leaders converge in New Delhi: sources
description: The visit comes as New Delhi prepares to host a major AI summit expected to draw top executives from Meta, Google, and Anthropic. This will be Altman's first visit to the country in nearly a year.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Only 1 week left (or until the first 500 passes are gone): The first TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket discount is ending
description: Register now to save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass and get a second ticket at 50% off. This offer ends next week on January 30, or once the first 500 tickets are claimed — whichever comes first.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Former Sequoia partner’s new startup uses AI to negotiate your calendar for you
description: Blockit, an AI agent that communicates directly with other calendars, has raised $5 million in seed funding led by Sequoia.
author: Marina Temkin

title: OpenAI is coming for those sweet enterprise dollars in 2026
description: OpenAI has reportedly appointed Barret Zoph to lead its push into enterprise just a week after Zoph rejoined the company.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Voice AI engine and OpenAI partner LiveKit hits $1B valuation
description: The five-year-old-startup powers OpenAI’s ChatGPT voice mode and raised a $100 million round led by Index Ventures.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Inference startup Inferact lands $150M to commercialize vLLM
description: The seed round values the newly formed startup at $800 million.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Are AI agents ready for the workplace? A new benchmark raises doubts
description: New research looks at how leading AI models hold up doing actual white-collar work tasks, drawn from consulting, investment banking, and law. Most models failed.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Google DeepMind CEO is ‘surprised’ OpenAI is rushing forward with ads in ChatGPT
description: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis says the tech giant isn't pressuring him to insert ads into the AI chatbot experience.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Humans& thinks coordination is the next frontier for AI, and they’re building a model to prove it
description: Humans&, a new startup founded by alumni of Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, xAI, and Google DeepMind, is building the next generation of foundation models for collaboration, not chat.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google now offers free SAT practice exams, powered by Gemini
description: Students can prompt Gemini by typing "I want to take a practice SAT test,” and the AI will provide them with a free practice exam. Gemini then analyzes the results, highlighting strengths and identifying areas that need further review. It also offers detailed explanations for any incorrect answers.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Google’s AI Mode can now tap into your Gmail and Photos to provide tailored responses
description: The company notes that AI Mode doesn’t train directly on your Gmail inbox or Google Photos library. Instead, it trains on specific prompts and the model’s responses.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Google reportedly snags team behind AI voice startup Hume AI
description: Google has hired the CEO and top engineer behind voice AI startup Hume AI, signaling that voice is increasingly becoming the preferred interface over screens.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: From invisibility cloaks to AI chips: Neurophos raises $110M to build tiny optical processors for inferencing
description: Neurophos is taking a crack at solving the AI industry's power efficiency problem with an optical chip that uses a composite material to do the math required in AI inferencing tasks.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Anthropic has to keep revising its technical interview test as Claude improves
description: The issue of AI cheating is already wreaking havoc at schools and universities around the world, so it's ironic that AI labs are having to deal with it too. But Anthropic is also uniquely well-equipped to deal with the problem.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Spotify brings AI-powered Prompted Playlists to the U.S. and Canada
description: Now available in the US and Canada, Spotify's AI-powered Prompted Playlists let users describe what they want to hear using natural language commands.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Quadric rides the shift from cloud AI to on-device inference — and it’s paying off
description: Quadric aims to help companies and governments build programmable on-device AI chips that can run fast-changing models locally.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Former Google trio is building an interactive AI-powered learning app for kids
description: Big tech companies and upcoming startups want to use generative AI to build software and hardware for kids. A lot of those experiences are limited to text or voice, and kids might not find that captivating. Three former Google employees want to get over that hurdle with their generative AI-powered interactive app, Sparkli. Sparkli was […]
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Not to be outdone by OpenAI, Apple is reportedly developing an AI wearable
description: Should this wearable materialize, it could be released as early as 2027, according to a report on the device.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Sources: Project SGLang spins out as RadixArk with $400M valuation as inference market explodes
description: SGLang, which originated as an open source research project at Ion Stoica’s UC Berkeley lab, has raised capital from Accel.
author: Marina Temkin

title: A timeline of the US semiconductor market in 2025
description: From leadership changes at legacy semiconductor companies to wishy washy policy around chip exports, a lot happened last year.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Todoist’s app now lets you add tasks to your to-do list by speaking to its AI
description: The feature, now public, lets you create to-do's and action items by speaking naturally to the app's AI.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Apple plans to make Siri an AI chatbot, report says
description: Siri could look more like ChatGPT than its current state as an integrated feature across Apple products.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Anthropic revises Claude’s ‘Constitution,’ and hints at chatbot consciousness
description: The newly revised document offers a roadmap for what Anthropic says is a safer and more helpful chatbot experience.
author: Lucas Ropek
